# MoreMass Fleshweaver full-moon creation

Sample19 Ring3 (LazarusLeague/LunaCoven, seed68586509, Covenant0) reaches a
native BattleIntro after two uninterrupted default-budget win pairs. Its
planner rejects the first deployment EndTurn because the existing moon birth
calibration covers the Corruption Fleshweaver, not the MoreMass definition.

The isolated native probe deploys champion1 on floor2 and ends deployment.
Source0.2.198 retains the rejected forecast and both original successors.
The native first turn creates MoreMass actor5 at full moon, keeping authored
600HP, base6 attack plus8 mass at2 damage per stack (22 total), then installs
the fullmoon state after mass. The ordered registry is mass/fullmoon and the
moon mask is6. Complete two-input state/RNG matches0.2.199; four detached
EndTurns preserve the parent, and five unknown-definition controls reject.

0.2.199 admits only that definition at the observed full-moon creation frame,
while retaining the existing no-moon-trigger, original status/upgrade and
identity/birth guards. The old Corruption/full-moon native pair remains a
targeted control. Independent pinned replay and a new default third-battle
source/reward pair remain required before whole-battle acceptance.
